'''Wicke''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as a [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] in the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|army]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] in [[3642 BBY]]. Stationed in [[Camp Vigil]], he was corrupt, even collaborating with enemies of the Empire like the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] that would be later known as [[Voidhound]] and the [[Balmorran resistance|resistance fighter]] [[Numen Brock]], in exchange for [[Stimulant/Legends|stims]].
